title: Locked-Rate Credit for Registered Manufacturer Parts Warranties (Comfort Club)
content:
Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements members whose Harbison installation carries a long manufacturer parts warranty receive a credit on the locked rate of a reinstated term. The rule reads the manufacturer registrations recorded on the member's installations under Replacement System Installations, and looks at the longest registered parts warranty.

## Registration credit rule
- A member whose Harbison installation carries a manufacturer registration confirming a parts warranty of **twelve years or more** receives the twelve-year registration credit of **6.00 USD**.
- A member whose longest registered parts warranty is **ten or eleven years** receives the ten-year registration credit of **3.00 USD**.
- Any other member receives none.

## Longest registered parts warranty to credit

| Longest registered parts warranty | Credit |
|---|---|
| 12 years or more | 6.00 |
| 10 or 11 years | 3.00 |
| Under 10 years, or no manufacturer registration on record | none |

## Basis questions
**Two installations, one registered at 10 years and one at 12?** The longest registration counts: 6.00.

**An installation with no manufacturer registration filed?** No registration, no credit.
